name: Morpho Ethena x Steakhouse USDG vault

requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key
A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
Bypass paths of the delay checked and ruled out
Price feed not under one hand
No key shared with another tracked protocol

exit_window: a confirmed delay, bypass paths checked

narrative.summary: The largest raw multisig found on this chain - a real 5-of-10 Safe at owner - still capped by the same zero-delay authority gap, and shares its curator Safe with the Steakhouse vault.
narrative.detail: ~$23.6M TVL, the largest single TVL found on this chain. curator() is the identical 3-of-7 Safe as the Morpho Steakhouse USDG vault - all 7 owners overlap, dropping both vaults' crossExposureScore from 100 to 80 (batch 7). owner() resolves two hops through a non-Safe contract to a real 5-of-10 Safe. Best-governed vault found on this chain, but setOwner/setCurator timelocks are still 0. Not flagged as a hidden risk: Steakhouse Financial curating two vaults on the same chain is a normal, visible relationship - but it is still a real fact a lending market treating these as independently-governed collateral would get wrong.
